content: The daemon owns canonical absolute-row terminal truth and no client state. Every logical body publication is a contiguous absolute range, while the client cache may be sparse. The target client buffer is a configurable absolute-row rolling window with a 3000-line default; this decision does not define its maximum. Initial connection is head/tail first, then a contiguous catch of at most three screens; older history is on demand. Reconnect preserves useful in-range cached rows. Renderer owns visible range, follow, reading and renderBottomIndex; buffer owns hole detection and range repair. Stable/live is not a client buffer or renderer layer, and the daemon cannot lock stable TUI rows because it does not own reflow truth.
title: Confirmed terminal daemon buffer and renderer contract

content: The confirmed target client uses Cordis as the production composition and lifecycle owner. Transport, session, buffer, and renderer are fixed Cordis services/nodes; UI and business capabilities are plugins. Cordis carries lifecycle and capability control, never terminal, file, or media body payloads. Current production still uses ClientCompositionRoot plus the local PluginHost, while CordisAdapter is Playground-only; migration must end with one production composition owner and no retained dual path.
title: Cordis client composition target
